svg.text: A dashed LINE (pattern 0xF0F0) that leaves the clip rectangle
inclusive: the edge pixels are drawn
VALUE bits 31–16, the pattern: one bit a pixel, from bit 31, round again after 16
From (6, 4) to (37, 14): WIDTH 32, HEIGHT 10. Small numbers: the pixel's place in the line;
the pattern keeps counting through clipped pixels, so the dashes stay where they were.
